Texts that hold no secret: code, prose, docs, chat-like lines written by
hand, SHAs, UUIDs, and op:// and $VAR references. A rule set that changes one
loses text for nothing. See README.md for the format.

=== negative docs heading and steps
## Rotating the deploy token

1. Open the vault entry.
2. Generate a new token.
3. Update the CI variable, then revoke the old one.
